protocol.previous_goal_turn: progress: af0aa0f measured and pushed; current JIT address attribution committed as ff8f96a, all48 diagnostic outputs correct. Full parity remains open.
protocol.specific: Track canonical registers for exact-type/layout array/record reference copies within one native segment. Use the canonical checked binding at subsequent accesses; invalidate compile-time relations on source overwrite, native call/return and independently enterable segment boundaries. Preserve materialized VM values, bounds, generations and all guards.
protocol.evidence: cp42-jit-address-attribution-2026-09-11: DSU847/1580 and BFS669/1381 mapped generated samples in index proofs plus reads; machine code repeats checked binding after full-reference copies. Sampling supports testing the removal, not a speedup claim.
protocol.early_gate: After focused alias/state/native/fuel/root/failure tests: 3 warmups+11 paired unchanged DSU/BFS/min-heap samples; geometric mean latency reduction >=8%, no median >2% or P90 >5% regression among these cases.
protocol.full_gate: All32 unchanged JIT paired comparisons,114 source/harness hashes, original arguments/stdout,64MiB. Median >2% or P90 >5% gets exactly one confirmation; repeated same metric rejects. JIT sum of medians must improve >=3%. Default interpreter must retain its accepted all32 regression gate, either fresh execution or explicit byte-identical binary/source-dependency reuse.
protocol.validation: Full ON and focused ASan/UBSan, Rosetta plus all32 correctness; cold/JIT differentials at all finite/shared fuel boundaries, aliases and overwritten sources, branch joins, calls, GC, bounds and generation failures, all reachable deterministic allocation/code-policy failures, both zero ledgers. Required architecture/memory/docs/generated gates before main commit/push. No builds/tests/profilers during acceptance timings.
protocol.limits: JIT stays opt-in. Local acceptance does not close full Tier1/Linux LSan or Go/Rust parity.
protocol.variant: v2: add same-segment record-field read reuse to the exact-reference alias analysis. Record mutation is unsupported/cold, and native calls/entries reset proofs. Preserve first failure location and exact instruction fuel. Original early/full gates and 08:13 deadline remain.
protocol.preceding_variant: Geometric latency target passed (10.015% reduction), but min-heap P90 ratio 1.072946 exceeded unchanged 1.05 early threshold. No timing rerun or code-causality claim.
